meta.note: Recorded public datasets replayed through the Enerlytics physics; the battery dispatch is a scenario. Nothing on this page is a live feed.

site.name: DKASC Alice Springs · array 1B (Trina, 23.4 kWp, dual-axis tracker)
site.poaBasis: Perez transposition onto the tracked plane from GHI/DHI/DNI (ADR-017)

forecast.method: clear-sky (Ineichen) × Perez transposition × Faiman cell temperature × block-6 power model; sky by persistence of yesterday's clear-sky index; scaled by the plant's trailing 30-day actual/model ratio

pvFaults.source: Lazzaretti et al. 2020 (UTFPR), 5.28 kWp, 16 days, labelled faults, 1-minute means

calibration.note: The baseline is fitted once on a declared healthy period and then frozen. Degradation detection falls with it — a slow decline is a shift in the healthy relationship, so a baseline refitted on recent data would absorb it. Degradation is read as baseline drift over time instead.

inverterFleet.path: DC V×I vs AC (block 6 Path E)

nasa.source: NASA PCoE Battery Data Set (18650, 2 Ah), cells B0005/6/7/18 at 24 °C

severson.source: Severson et al. 2019 (A123 LFP 18650, 1.1 Ah), fast-charge batch 2018-02-20

definitions.rte: IEC 62933-2-1 §5.2.3: E_out / E_in over an SOC-neutral cycle

dispatch.scenarioNote: Scenario — a measured chiller-plant load (2013) and a measured PV shape (Alice Springs 2014, scaled to 250 kWp) with an assumed 300 kWh / 150 kW battery under the MIS May–Jul rates. Connect a site's own PV and meter to make this operational.

assumptions.tariff: APSR CRT 2025 MIS BST, May–Jul: OP 19 · WDP 36 · NP 46 Bz/kWh; no export tariff (surplus curtailed at zero value); capacity charge CPR 7,691 OMR/MW·yr priced per day (÷365) on the daily peak import
assumptions.solver: linear program (HiGHS via scipy.optimize.linprog); closed daily cycle; η_c = η_d = √η_rt

standards: IEC 61724-1:2021 (PR, yields, availability, Class A/B accuracy)
